commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Lord of Tresserhorn ({1}{U}{B}{R} Legendary Creature — Zombie 10/4; me1, released 2007-09-10; oracle_id 283e7a23-ae25-48d1-abb5-cd021f66cc29). Commander-legal on live Scryfall, not a Game Changer, no project exception. Oracle (frozen cache and live, identical): 'When Lord of Tresserhorn enters, you lose 2 life, you sacrifice two creatures, and target opponent draws two cards. {B}: Regenerate Lord of Tresserhorn.' There is no opponent-regeneration clause; the regeneration is Lord's own, for {B}. Plan (owner 2026-10-14): turn off or pay the enters trigger (Torpor Orb, Karn, Dress Down, Stifle, Tale's End; or cheap recursive fodder — Bitterblossom, Reassembling Skeleton, Gravecrawler, Bloodghast, Nether Traitor), then win with a 10-power commander: Uncaged Fury for 22 commander damage, infect (Phyresis, Tainted Strike, Kediss spreading damage), Pain for All with Blasphemous Act while {B} regenerates Lord, plus the aristocrat loops Spellbook lists. Every add serves that plan: Consign counters the trigger, Ornithopter and BMC's changeling are fodder, Skullclamp turns fodder into cards, Fierce Guardianship is free once Lord is out.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 (Optimized; owner-approved), unchanged. Game Changers 2 -> 3 (Demonic Tutor, Vampiric Tutor; + Fierce Guardianship). Commander Spellbook: 19 included combos in baseline, candidate and every alternative (including the two-card Gravecrawler + Phyrexian Altar loop, which needs another Zombie), none new and none lost; almost-included 283 -> 289. No new infinite is claimed; Skullclamp with Bitterblossom or recursive creatures is bounded card advantage.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first to Lord's actual Oracle text: each add answers or monetises his enters trigger (counter it, feed it, draw off it) or protects him for free. No generic combo package (Thassa's Oracle line, rejected by the author), no owner-removed card (Temur Battle Rage) and no author-rejected card that Pass C did not reopen (Embercleave, Psychotic Fury, Glistening Oil, Mask of Griselbrand, Rhystic Study, Cyclonic Rift, Phyrexian Dreadnought) is added. Fierce Guardianship and Distortion Strike were author-rejected but reopened by Pass C. Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the 61 other project exports, baseline -> candidate): Tresserhorn's Lord, Returned 52 -> 51; Garza Zol 50 -> 48; Thraximundar 47 -> 48; Nicol Bolas 47 -> 46; Marchesa 46 -> 46. 18 candidate nonbasics appear in none of the top four: Anger, Consign to Memory, Dress Down, Headless Rider, Karn, Argent Defender, Lord of Tresserhorn, Muddle the Mixture, Nether Traitor, Ornithopter of Paradise, Phyresis, Shambling Ghast, Stifle, Tainted Strike, Tale's End, Torpor Orb, Uncaged Fury, Undead Augur, Wonder. Homogenization disclosed: Fierce Guardianship is in 54/61 other decks; Consign and Ornithopter in 0; BMC 14 and Skullclamp 6 (both also in Tresserhorn's Lord, Returned).

material_candidates.commander_synergy: Lord's trigger makes an opponent draw two, so a Bowmasters already on the battlefield pings twice and builds a 2/2 Army that is fodder for the next sacrifice; it also punishes opponents' wheels and extra draws.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: The owner's protected suppression core (Torpor Orb, Karn, Dress Down, Stifle, Tale's End) turns off Lord's trigger, and Torpor/Karn also blank Bowmasters' own enter; Lord's trigger resolves sacrifice before the draw, so Bowmasters is often the sacrificed body. A fourth Game Changer. Not measured in this pass.
material_candidates.reason: Anti-synergy with the owner-protected suppression plan; unmeasured; not better than Nightscape Familiar (cost reducer and fodder).

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Five swaps that each serve Lord's actual enters trigger: Consign counters it, Ornithopter and BMC's changeling feed it, Skullclamp draws off it, Fierce Guardianship protects Lord for free. Costs: spot removal 5 -> 3 and hard enchantment answers down to Chaos Warp; Game Changers 2 -> 3 (Bracket 4 unchanged); Fierce Guardianship is the most homogenizing card (54/61 other decks); Stubborn Denial is an owner-cycle add and the other four cuts were owner audit keeps — all flagged. Lands stay at 35; Spellbook included combos stay at 19.

low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: Lord's printed drawback — two creatures sacrificed, two cards to an opponent — was handled by suppression and fodder, but four slots (a fear enchantment Shizo duplicates, a non-creature rock, a soft counter and an off-plan edict) neither paid nor protected that trigger, and the deck had no way to turn its sacrificed fodder into cards.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: The five-swap floor was reached with five swaps that each stand on Lord's own Oracle text; it was not used as a target. Every remaining incumbent was re-read against the pool: five post-floor challenges were recorded (Muddle, Rogue's Passage, Pain for All, Terminate, Nightscape Familiar) and two six-swap packages (Distortion−Rogue's, Aqueous−Muddle) are staged as complete 100s.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Aqueous connects 15/24 B1 cells vs Cover 12, but Rogue's Passage and Shizo remain and the package scores .6637 vs .6613 (noise) while losing Muddle's transmute for Dress Down, Torpor Orb or Karn.
Distortion gives two unblockable turns for {U} but cutting the land drops to 34 and turn-6 deployment to .6490; Passage repeats every turn without a card.
TBR kills more B2 cells (174 vs 108) but is an owner cut (20 commander damage reason) and Pain is the owner's Blasphemous Act reflection line; inadmissible.
Soul's Fire kills the most B2 cells (216/972) but needs Lord in play and answers only 4/14 B3 threats; Terminate is unconditional instant removal and spot removal is already down to 3.
Bowmasters pings on Lord's opponent draws but anti-synergises with Torpor Orb, Karn and Dress Down and is a fourth Game Changer; Nightscape reduces Lord's cost and is fodder.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Pass C Phase B item 4: does a sixth swap, Distortion Strike over Rogue's Passage at 34 lands, add enough evasion to justify the land cut?
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Turn-6 P(Lord on battlefield) .6490 vs candidate .6613; Rogue's Passage repeats evasion without a card, and 35 lands is the owner's 2026-10-14 count.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: A sixth swap making Lord unblockable for {U} with Aqueous Form over Muddle the Mixture, since Cover of Darkness is already gone.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Measured .6637 vs .6613 is within noise, Muddle is an owner add that tutors Dress Down, Torpor Orb or Karn, and Rogue's Passage plus Shizo already give evasion.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped at five because no sixth swap beats its incumbent: both six-swap packages are within noise or worse on deployment (.6637 and .6490 vs .6613) and cost an owner add or the 35th land; TBR, Embercleave, Psychotic Fury and Glistening Oil are owner- or author-rejected; cutting Terminate would take spot removal to 2; Bowmasters fights the owner's suppression core.
